articles.title: SteamOS 3.9.7 Beta and SteamOS 0.5.11 Beta for Steam Frame released
articles.summary: Two new Beta releases of SteamOS to cover this morning - one for everyone, and another for the Steam Frame VR headset. Below we'll list all the changes across the two different SteamOS builds to save you clicking around.

articles.title: Kotlin Heroes: Episode 15 – Anniversary Edition
articles.summary: Kotlin turned 15 this year, and we’re celebrating with the 15th episode of Kotlin Heroes! 💜 Kotlin Heroes is a series of online programming contests, where participants solve algorithmic problems using Kotlin.

articles.title: sd2snes+: Alternate FXPak Pro Firmware
articles.summary: Developer Luan Freitas has been working on an alternate firmware for Ikari’s FX Pax Pro, which was originally called the “SD2SNES”…hence the “SD2SNES+” name. This firmware adds a ton of features and there’s even wireless networking options, if you connect an ESP32-S3 (N16R8 variant) to the ROM Cart’s USB port.

articles.title: Sega Saturn Portable Pays Homage to the Sega CDX Design
articles.summary: The mod began with trimming down a Sega Saturn motherboard to squeeze inside a Sanyo portable CD player. A custom 3D-printed bottom case was used in order to accommodate the Saturn’s controller ports as well as integrate the original CD player’s control buttons for music playback.

articles.title: 9to5Mac Daily: November 25, 2026 – CarPlay Ultra update, iPad rumors
articles.summary: Listen to a recap of the top stories of the day from 9to5Mac . 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes and Apple’s Podcasts app , Stitcher , TuneIn , Google Play , or through our dedicated RSS feed for Overcast and other podcast players.

articles.title: ‘Enough Phone’ is stuffing a bigger battery, more RAM & storage into its small Android phone at no extra cost
articles.summary: The “Enough Phone” is trying to fulfill the small Android phone dream and, now, it’s getting some spec upgrades to the battery, RAM, and storage, all with no added cost.

articles.title: SteamVR Beta v2.19.5 brings more Steam Link Streaming improvements
articles.summary: Another Beta release with SteamVR v2.19.5 now available for testing, bringing with it even more Steam Link Streaming improvements. Since the release of the Steam Frame, Valve have been doing a lot of extra improvements to SteamVR lately, and getting it working better on Linux too - really nice to see.

articles.title: Hello Weather is the best Apple Weather app on Android
articles.summary: Hello Weather started out on iOS before coming to Android a few years ago. On Apple devices, the app got a big redesign last year, and it just came to Android last month with a promise that updates will roll out to both platforms at the same time going forward.

articles.title: The next-generation Linux gaming display MangoHud v0.8.5-rc1 first test build is out
articles.summary: MangoHud is an invaluable tool for Linux gaming, giving you a fully-featured display of system and game performance stats. A new next-gen version is here.

articles.title: iOS 27.3 release date: Here’s when new iPhone features are coming
articles.summary: iPhone Duo also benefits from three exciting new features , including face unlock, Reachability, and a new setting to automatically lock the device when closed.

articles.title: Android Auto update improves support for wide displays, but not everyone will see it [Gallery]
articles.summary: Google has rolled out a new update for Android Auto that improves support for wider display formats, but there’s a good chance you won’t be able to see it.

articles.title: Copilot code review billing will default to the organization
articles.summary: If you haven’t chosen how to bill Copilot code review for members with a Copilot license, those reviews will be billed to your organization starting December 30, 2026.

articles.title: 2013 classic exploration game Proteus gets a 2026 upgrade for Linux
articles.summary: Proteus is a blast from the 2013 past, a highly rated exploration walking-sim that just got a nice upgrade to keep the Linux version running nicely.

articles.title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.33160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts.

articles.title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
articles.summary: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check.

articles.title: AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics
articles.summary: AI systems are increasingly capable of producing machine-checked Lean proofs of advanced mathematical results. Real mathematical formalization, however, is not isolated theorem proving: it requires building the definitions and intermediate lemmas that connect a result to a formal library.

articles.title: General-Purpose Decision Models for AI Configuration Tuning
articles.summary: AI configuration tuning searches for settings that improve the performance of AI systems under a limited budget. Existing tuners use different sampling and search policies, making the choice of decision strategy central to both tuning quality and cost.

articles.title: XNULinux lets you run macOS on Linux without a VM
articles.summary: While you can already run macOS on Linux in a virtual machine, XNULinux doesn’t rely on virtualisation or hypervisors 1 which makes the feature more impressive.

articles.title: KosmicKrisp Now The Go-To Solution For Vulkan On Macs In Place Of MoltenVK
articles.summary: While MoltenVK began as an initiative to layer the Vulkan API atop Apple's Metal for use on macOS and iOS, the KosmicKrisp effort spearheaded by LunarG is now the go-to solution for Vulkan API support on modern Apple devices.

articles.title: Claude artifacts can now be installed as desktop apps (just not on Linux)
articles.summary: Claude now lets users install artifacts, small interactive tools the LLM can create inside of chats, as standalone(ish) desktop apps. When added via the ‘Install as app’, artifacts run in their own window with their own icon.

articles.title: Pop!_OS 26.04 LTS Released With More COSMIC Apps, Remote Desktop & More
articles.summary: System76 has a wonderful surprise today with the release of Pop!_OS 26.04 LTS as the newest iteration of their in-house Linux distribution now built atop the Ubuntu 26.04 LTS package base and incorporating their latest enhancements to their COSMIC desktop.
